description: This file defines and exports an enumeration and related constants and functions for managing different vector store providers within a UI component. It includes provider identifiers, logo mappings, configuration field structures, and helper functions for retrieving logos, display names, and provider-specific configuration fields.

methods.name: getVectorStoreProviderLogoAndName
methods.description: Returns the logo URL and display name for a given provider value, matching it against the predefined provider mappings and enum.

methods.name: getProviderSpecificFields
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration fields specific to a given provider value.
